paragraphs.text: Ehtrimik , known as the Imagined Fiend , is an illusory fiend on Duskmourn .

Ehtrimik is a character that was introduced in Alchemy: Duskmourn . It has a terrifying appearance, with a large, white, furry body, three-clawed arms, large white eyes without pupils, and a wide mouth with rows of sharp, menacing teeth. Parts of its face lack skin, showing the bare muscle and tissue beneath. Although this beast is an illusion , it is real enough to kill. He buffs other creatures the player controls, but inversely, he cannot attack or block if the player controls any other creature.
